khagankhan opened issue #14301:

Found by the gc_ops fuzz target and reduced to a standalone .wast, so there is no
libFuzzer input or cargo fuzz fmt output to paste.

wasmtime 50.0.0-dev (596675762 2026-09-08)

ref.test against a concrete struct type, on an anyref that came from
any.convert_extern of a host externref, loads the reserved
VMSharedTypeIndex (u32::MAX) out of the object's VMGcHeader and hands it
to the is_subtype libcall.

Reproduce

minimal.wast:

(module
  (type $s (sub (struct)))
  (func (export "run") (param externref) (result i32)
    local.get 0
    any.convert_extern
    ref.test (ref null $s)))

(assert_return (invoke "run" (ref.extern 1)) (i32.const 0))

any.convert_extern of a host externref, loads the reserved
VMSharedTypeIndex (u32::MAX) out of the object's VMGcHeader and hands it
to the is_subtype libcall.

Reproduce

minimal.wast:

(module
  (type $s (sub (struct)))
  (func (export "run") (param externref) (result i32)
    local.get 0
    any.convert_extern
    ref.test (ref null $s)))

(assert_return (invoke "run" (ref.extern 1)) (i32.const 0))
